# FQHESphereShowBasis

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereShowBasis`

```text
FQHESphereShowBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereShowBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -l, --nbr-flux : number of flux quanta (default value = 20)
    --nbrflux-2 : number of flux quanta for the second sphere on the S2XS2 geometry (default value = 20)
    -z, --lz-value : twice the total lz value (default value = 0)
    --jz-value : twice the total value of jz (only useful in the bosonic 4D mode) (default value = 0)
    --kz-value : twice the total value of kz (only useful in the bosonic 4D mode) (default value = 0)
    --tz-value : the total value of Tz (only useful in the bosonic CP2 mode) (default value = 0)
    --y-value : the total value of Y (only useful in the bosonic CP2 mode) (default value = 0)
    --all-lz : consider particles with all Lz components
    --fermion : use fermionic statistic instead of bosonic statistic
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --su2-spin : consider particles with SU(2) spin
    --use-alt : use alternative Hilbert space for the SU(2) spinful bosonic states
    --4-D : consider particles on the 4D sphere (only available in the bosonic mode)
    --cp2 : consider particles on the CP2 
    --s2xs2 : consider particles on the S2xS2 geometry
    --s2s2-hardcorenonn : consider particles on the S2xS2 geometry, with hardcore contraint and no nearest neighbor
    --truncated-cp2 : consider particles on a truncated CP2 geometry
    --min-y : minimum value of y for a truncated CP2 geometry (default value = 0)
    --tzZ3symmetrized-basis : use Tz <-> -Tz and Z3 permutations symmetrized version of the CP2 basis (only valid if total-tz=0 and total-y = 0)
    --minus-tzparity : select the  Tz <-> -Tz symmetric sector with negative parity
    -s, --total-sz : twice the z component of the total spin of the system (only useful in su(2)/su(4) mode) (default value = 0)
    --lzsymmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --szsymmetrized-basis : use Sz <-> -Sz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-sz=0)
    --minus-szparity : select the  Sz <-> -Sz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --minus-lzparity : select the  Lz <-> -Lz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --all-sz : consider particles with SU(2) spin all Sz components
    --add-index : add index of the Hilbert space vectors
    --add-szvalue : add Sz value to each Hilbert space vector (valid only for all-sz)
    --nbrspin-polarized : number of orbitals which ar fully spin up polarized (from the one with the lowest momentum) (default value = 0)
    --use-pairing : only fix Sz and not the number of particles
    --su3-spin : consider particles with SU(3) spin
    --quasiholes : consider fermions with spin, where only the (k, r) partitions are admitted for each spin -- only available in use-pairing fermionic mode
    --total-tz : twice the quantum number of the system associated to the Tz generator (only useful in su(3) mode) (default value = 0)
    --total-y : three time the quantum number of the system associated to the Y generator (only useful in su(3) mode) (default value = 0)
    --su4-spin : consider particles with SU(4) spin
    --2-ll : consider particles within two Landau levels
    --restrict-polarization : restrict number of particles in each Landau level (provided by nbrparticles-up and nbrparticles-down)
    --nbrparticles-up : number of particles in N=1 LL (default value = 0)
    --nbrparticles-down : number of particles in N=0 LL (default value = 0)
    --3-ll : consider particles within three Landau levels
    --4-ll : consider particles within four Landau levels
    -i, --total-isosz : twice the z component of the total isospin of the system (only usefull in su(4) mode) (default value = 0)
    -e, --total-entanglement : twice the projection of the total spin-isopsin entanglement of the system (only usefull in su(4) mode) (default value = 0)
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state
    --rational : use rational numbers instead of double precision floating point numbers
    --state : name of an optional vector state whose component values can be displayed behind each corresponding n-body state
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    -c, --complex-vector : vector state is complex instead of real
    --hide-component : hide state components (and thus the corresponding n-body state) whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)
    --get-index : find the index of a given n-body state
    --pauli : print only states obeying a general Pauli exclusion principle

output options:
    --variance : show state variance
    --save-disk : save output on disk
    --output-file : use this file name instead of statistics_sphere_suN_n_nbrparticles_q_nbrfluxquanta_z_totallz.basis

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
